product_launches.description: Sendoso has launched the beta of its Model Context Protocol (Sendoso MCP), enabling enterprise AI agents to trigger personalized gifting and direct mail and integrating with partners like Demandbase, UserGems, Gong, Outreach, Clay, and Warmly.

overview_description.description: Sendoso is a sending platform that helps companies stand out by giving them new ways to engage with customers throughout the buyer’s journey. By integrating digital and physical sending strategies, companies can increase the effectiveness of their existing go-to-market programs and improve their relationships with customers. Trusted by over 500 companies, Sendoso is an essential part of successful demand generation, account-based, and customer experience programs. Founded in 2016, Sendoso is backed by $54M in venture funding and has a global footprint, with a presence in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Learn more at sendoso.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Sendoso helps companies connect and drive revenue with personalized gifts, eGifts, virtual experiences, and more.

product.name: Sendoso Sending Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating, automating, and tracking personalized gifts, eGifts, branded merchandise, virtual experiences, direct mail, and handwritten notes.

product.name: SmartSuite
product.description: An AI-powered set of tools for recommending gifts, generating personalized messages, identifying delivery addresses, and analyzing sending performance.

product.name: Sendoso Fulfillment Center
product.description: A managed fulfillment service for procuring, storing, packaging, shipping, and returning gifts and direct-mail items worldwide.

product.name: Merch by Sendoso
product.description: A self-service service for sourcing, producing, and managing custom branded merchandise and on-demand swag.

product.name: The Campaign Studio
product.description: A managed campaign service that develops and executes branded gifting, direct-mail, and experiential campaigns from planning through completion.

product.name: Event Fulfillment
product.description: A fulfillment service for shipping, storing, managing, and returning branded materials and gifts used at in-person events.
